title: BACKND Base group data
summary: Read and manage console-defined groups: list group tables, fetch groups (with paging via LastEvaluatedKey), get group members, and update group data. Groups underpin group-segmented features such as segmented leaderboards.
capabilities: route group lookup and membership questions to the group family
explain paging with LastEvaluatedKey for large group lists
prerequisites: Groups are configured in the BACKND console
SDK is initialized and the user is logged in for member-scoped reads
common_pitfalls: Calling group list via SendQueue (not supported)
Ignoring LastEvaluatedKey paging when more than the limit exists
Conflating group membership with guild membership
verification_required_for: exact method names and return objects
how group segmentation maps to leaderboards
verification_strategy: Use https://docs.backnd.com plus the source route before generating group queries.
Confirm group-to-leaderboard segmentation behavior from the official pages.
public_notes: Groups support segmented features; verify exact APIs upstream.
